description: Loopback proxies that route a tab's traffic for chosen hostnames to a fixed IP

functions.name: startHostProxy
functions.description: Starts (or reuses) the loopback proxy for an IP and returns its port

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address every proxied connection goes to

functions.name: getHostProxyStatus
functions.description: Returns the log file path and each running proxy's port, connection counts and last error

functions.name: stopHostProxy
functions.description: Stops the loopback proxy for an IP and closes its open connections
